ground_atlas.mask: Exact source fine-grass mask; full huerta, house, pool, tree wells and boundary remain original scanned substrate. No geometry overlay.
ground_atlas.prefilter: Linear-light area prefilter: source 2m tiles reduced to512px color /256px normal+roughness before atlas sampling; prevents minification aliasing.
ground_atlas.color_tint: Original point-color attributes barycentrically interpolated and baked; original geometry is unchanged.

roughness_lod.method: Normal-variance specular AA inspired by Toksvig; approximate GGX adaptation. r_eff = min(1,(r^4 + strength^2*(1-L)/max(L,0.05))^0.25), L=length(area-filtered source normal), strength=0.65. Applied only to the derived understory; original bare-ground roughness unchanged.

correcciones99_agua_optica_r8.py.scope: Optical bump only; no vertex, volume, surface level, basin, colour, absorption or IOR changes.
correcciones99_agua_optica_r8.py.reason: The earlier optical bump distance represented8.28mm effective modulation and looked choppy in the human-height pool view. Reduce the optical height multiplier to1.84mm for subtle wind ripple; no hydraulic simulation or wave-amplitude certification.
